Chaos crashes into hope.
In Supergirl (2026), the universe gets a jolt of pure anarchy with the explosive reveal of Lobo. As Supergirl steps into her destiny, the arrival of the galaxy’s most ruthless bounty hunter signals that this fight won’t be clean — or merciful.

Starring Jason Momoa as Lobo and Milly Alcock as Kara Zor-El, this official 4K reveal trailer teases brutal action, cosmic stakes, and a clash of power and personality that will redefine DC’s future.

🔥 SUPERGIRL (2026) — hope meets havoc.
